headline: Improving CodeClip with Public Trend Signals
summary: By leveraging public trend signals, we can enhance CodeClip to better meet user needs and stay relevant. This includes improving code snippet categorization, integrating AI for smarter search, and enhancing user experience through modern web technologies.
